ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a five-membered ring structure, with two oxygen atoms contained in the ring; the two ring carbons on the left side are respectively connected to R and R¹ substituents, which can be represented by the wildcard atom *. The central carbon inside the ring on the right side is connected to two oxygens, and connects to the P(OMe)3 group to the right; there are also several curved arrows and charge-movement arrows in the figure, and these arrows need to be ignored, retaining only the atom connection relationships. Reasoning: Convert only the connection relationships according to the specified method. The five-membered ring can be written starting from one wildcard substituent as *C1O[C-]OC1*, in which the central carbon on the right side is the negatively charged [C-]. This [C-] is connected to a positively charged phosphonium group [P+], and phosphorus has three methoxy substituents, written as [P+](OC)(OC)OC. Attach this branch to [C-], obtaining SMILES: *C1O[C-]([P+](OC)(OC)OC)OC1*.

raw_record.question_text: What is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure shown in the image, ignoring the arrows?

method.method_draft: First inspect the drawing itself and disregard all curved arrows and charge-movement arrows. Convert only the atom connectivity into a molecular graph: start at the generic substituent/wildcard attached to the ring carbon, traverse the five-member ring as *-C1-O-[C-]-O-C1, attach the phosphonium group to the negatively charged central carbon, and expand the phosphorus substituents as three methoxy groups. Then write the resulting SMILES as *C1O[C-]([P+](OC)(OC)OC)OC1*.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一个五元环结构，环上包含两个氧原子；左侧两个环碳分别连有 R 和 R¹ 取代基，可用通配原子 * 表示。右侧环内的中心碳与两个氧相连，并向右连接到 P(OMe)3 基团；图中还有若干弯箭头和电荷移动箭头，需要忽略这些箭头，只保留原子连接关系。
推理：按指定方法只转换连接关系。五元环可从一个通配取代基开始写作 *C1O[C-]OC1*，其中右侧中心碳为带负电的 [C-]。该 [C-] 上连接一个带正电的膦鎓基团 [P+]，磷上有三个甲氧基取代基，写作 [P+](OC)(OC)OC。把该支链接到 [C-] 上，得到 SMILES：*C1O[C-]([P+](OC)(OC)OC)OC1*。

planner_metadata.image_role: Use the image to identify the transition-state structure while ignoring the curved arrows: a five-membered cyclic acetal-like ring with atom order C-O-C-O-C, the central carbon bearing a negative charge and bonded to a positively charged phosphorus, and the phosphorus bearing three methoxy substituents, P(OMe)3. Treat the unspecified R/R1 attachment on the ring as a wildcard substituent as represented in the answer.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question text to know the requested output is the SMILES expression of the shown transition-state structure and that arrows should be ignored.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Apply SMILES syntax rules: use ring index 1 for the cyclic C-O-[C-]-O-C framework, bracket atoms with formal charges as [C-] and [P+], encode each methoxy as OC, and use * for the generic/unspecified substituent. Curved-arrow annotations are mechanistic and are not encoded.
